cycle_cron.description: 6-field Quartz cron of the cycle, in UTC. Every six hours by default: a control loop that ticks faster than its measurement window can fill only measures noise. Documentation, not a params field of its own: a timer cell has no top-level `cron` param, the value lives inside the schedule at params.schedules[0].cron. Since GH #138 it is a LITERAL there rather than an environment token, so an instance retunes the cycle by overriding `schedules` (the key exists, which is what GH #294 asks of an override) or at runtime with a modify op by schedule_id -- and not by a colony-wide environment two loops would have to share.

description.purpose: The cycle tick. Six-field Quartz cron, UTC.
description.use_when: One per argus hive. Event triggers (a DLQ spike, a cost alert) are additional edges into ./meter, not a second timer.
description.not_in_scope: No judgement -- it emits a tick and nothing else.
